title: arenaria benthamii var. diffusa
intro: Arenaria benthamii var. diffusa, commonly known as the bentham's sandwort, is a plant species belonging to the carnation family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins have been identified in Arenaria benthamii var. diffusa, contributing to its medicinal properties.
